title: Portland Bluegrass Sunday Jam @ Artichoke Music
event_description: Open bluegrass jam session welcoming all skill levels. Acoustic instruments only. Join fellow bluegrass enthusiasts for an afternoon of traditional and contemporary bluegrass music in Portland's premier acoustic music venue.
event_venue_information:
About Artichoke Music

Artichoke Music has been a cornerstone of Portland's acoustic music community since 1973. This nonprofit community music center provides a welcoming space for musicians of all ages and abilities to discover learn and perform music.

Music Programming

The venue hosts live music Thursday through Sunday nights featuring acoustic folk Americana blues and jazz performances. Their intimate 50-person capacity creates an exceptional listening room atmosphere where audiences give performers their full attention.

Open Mic and Jam Sessions

Artichoke regularly hosts open mic nights including the Acoustic Village Open Mic and specialized sessions like Be Heard - An Open Mic for Women's Voices. The Portland Bluegrass Sunday Jam is a beloved tradition occurring on the 2nd and 4th Sundays with a $5 cover at the door.

Educational Mission

As a nonprofit organization Artichoke is dedicated to building community through music. They offer music classes workshops and provide a supportive environment for musicians to develop their craft and connect with fellow artists.

title: Ron Steen Jazz Jam @ Clyde's Prime Rib
event_description: Weekly jazz jam session hosted by the Godfather of Jazz Jams Ron Steen. Join Portland's premier jazz community for impromptu performances with top local and visiting musicians. All skill levels welcome to participate in this legendary Sunday night tradition.
event_venue_information:
About Clyde's Prime Rib

Clyde's Prime Rib has been home to the Ron Steen Jazz Jam for over a decade establishing itself as a cornerstone of Portland's jazz scene. This Northeast Portland restaurant combines fine dining with exceptional live jazz music.

Jazz Programming

Every Sunday night Clyde's hosts one of the city's most respected jazz jam sessions. Led by drummer Ron Steen - a Portland Jazz Master and member of the Oregon Music Hall of Fame - the jam attracts both established musicians and aspiring players looking to learn from experienced artists.

Community and Atmosphere

The venue provides a professional setting for jazz performance with quality sound and an attentive audience. Notable international jazz stars who visit Portland often stop by Steen's jams for impromptu performances making this a must-visit destination for serious jazz enthusiasts.

title: Ron Steen Vocal Jazz Jam @ Wilf's Restaurant & Jazz Bar
event_description: Specialized vocal jazz jam session featuring singers and instrumentalists. Led by renowned drummer Ron Steen this session focuses on the Great American Songbook and vocal jazz standards. A supportive environment for vocalists to practice their craft with professional musicians.
hosts: Ron Steen Lori Boone Steve Christofferson
event_venue_information:
About Wilf's Restaurant & Jazz Bar

Wilf's Restaurant & Jazz Bar is an elegant downtown Portland venue that has been a cornerstone of the city's jazz scene. Located in the heart of downtown the restaurant features top-of-the-line air filtration and a commitment to supporting local artists through their equity-based cover charge policy.

Live Music Programming

Wilf's features live jazz music Wednesday through Saturday evenings starting at 7 PM. The venue charges a $5 cover that goes directly to the performing artists reflecting their commitment to fair compensation for musicians. The restaurant offers both dining room and bar seating with excellent sightlines to the stage.

Jazz Jam Sessions

The Wednesday night Ron Steen Vocal Jazz Jam is a highlight of Portland's weekly jazz calendar. This session provides a rare opportunity for vocalists to perform with a professional rhythm section in an upscale setting. Reservations are recommended for the best seating.

title: Open Mic Friday @ Influence Music Hall
event_description: Portland area's longest-running open mic since 2006. Family-friendly all-ages event welcoming musicians of all skill levels. Three songs or 15 minutes per performer. Free beer wine and snacks provided. Supportive audience that gives full attention to performers.
backline: PA system grand piano guitars available
event_venue_information:
About Influence Music Hall

Since 2006 Influence Music Hall has been the host of Friday Night Open Mic. Founded by Evan Acey this Hillsboro venue is dedicated to family-friendly community art and music with appreciative and supportive audiences.

Open Mic Tradition

Every Friday night features an all-ages open mic from 7:00 PM until everyone has performed - often extending past 10 PM. The venue strictly enforces a no-talking policy during performances creating one of the most respectful listening environments in the Portland area. Performers get 3 songs or 15 minutes whichever comes first.

Facilities and Amenities

The hall features a great sound system and house instruments including a grand piano. Free beer wine and snacks are provided. They also host the Hillsboro Art Walk displaying local artists' paintings drawings and photography throughout the space.

Community Impact

Influence Music Hall is operated by Tualatin Valley Artists a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. Many musicians have sold CDs and landed paying gigs as a result of their performances here. The venue has become a fertile ground for emerging talent in the Portland metro area.

title: Monday Jazz Jam @ Produce Row Café
event_description: Weekly instrumental jazz jam session featuring Portland's finest young jazz musicians. Led by trumpet player Pablo Rivarola the session begins with an hour of jazz from a rotating house band followed by two hours of curated jamming.
event_venue_information:
About Produce Row Café

Produce Row Café has been a cornerstone of Portland's music scene since 1974. Originally opened as a breakfast café for produce dockworkers the venue was converted to a pub by the McMenamin brothers and has evolved into a beloved spot for craft beer and live music.

Music and Events

The venue hosts a diverse range of live music events including jazz sessions funk nights and DJ events. The Tuesday night jazz jam has become a Portland institution attracting both seasoned professionals and emerging talent. The café's basement-style venue creates an intimate casual atmosphere perfect for musical exploration.

Amenities and Atmosphere

Produce Row features a covered and heated patio multiple indoor spaces and a vast beer selection with over 20 taps and 200+ bottles. The Central Eastside Industrial District location provides easy access and ample street parking. The venue is known for its relaxed vibe and commitment to supporting local music.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ Hopworks Urban Brewery
event_description: Weekly vintage bluegrass jam session featuring classic tunes from the 1940s 50s and 60s. Led by Patrick and his rotating band this toe-tapping event celebrates hard-driving traditional bluegrass style with original songs and standards. All levels welcome.
event_venue_information:
About Hopworks Urban Brewery

Hopworks Urban Brewery is a popular Southeast Portland brewery that combines excellent craft beer with a strong commitment to sustainability and community engagement. The brewery features a spacious taproom and outdoor seating area.

Live Music

Hopworks regularly hosts live music events including the Thursday night vintage bluegrass jam session. The brewery provides a casual welcoming atmosphere perfect for musicians and fans to enjoy traditional bluegrass music while sampling their award-winning organic beers.

Food and Drink

The brewery offers a full menu of food including pizza burgers and vegetarian options all made with locally sourced ingredients when possible. Their extensive beer list features flagship brews seasonal offerings and limited releases.

title: Community Blues Jam @ Community Jams Studio
event_description: Bi-monthly blues jam celebrating blues and blues-inspired songs. Participants select songs from the library or bring their own. Welcoming environment for singers and instrumentalists to explore blues traditions and connect with fellow musicians.
venue_address: 2365 SW Cedar Hills Blvd Beaverton OR 97005
event_venue_information:
About Community Jams

Community Jams is a nonprofit organization dedicated to building community by creating an environment that connects musicians of all abilities through live music. The studio is conveniently located near the intersection of Highway 26 and Highway 217 in Beaverton with easy TriMet access via Bus Line 20.

Regular Jam Sessions

Community Jams hosts multiple weekly jam sessions including Monday No Request Refused Jam Monday Improv Jam Thursday Themed Jams Saturday Newcomer/Explorer Jam and bi-monthly Blues and Acoustic Jams. Each session is designed to be welcoming to musicians of all skill levels.

Mission and Support

The organization receives support from Pearl Jam's Future Days Fund the Fred W. Fields fund of Oregon Community Foundation and the Marie Lamfrom Charitable Foundation. They are also supported by the Oregon Arts Commission. Donations help cover the $24 per person per jam operating costs.
